task: ByteVerse homepage revamp: search-led tools directory hero, tool categories, curated guides, trust section, footer and header updates
status: Live on https://www.byteverse.fyi/ since 2026-11-28 (commit 8cb3dc7); validated locally and on the live site

preserved: All existing routes, tool URLs and article URLs
Organization, WebSite and WebPage structured data types
Existing Google Analytics tag (no new script)
Newsletter form, translation opt-in and the private image/CSV tool boundary
scope.validationData: Real published articles fetched read-only from the public site into a disposable credential-free production build; no production database or provider access during tests.

audit.previousHomepage: Tools-first design from October 2026 with the heading "Tools for your work. Ideas for what's next."
gaps: The main heading did not say what the site offers
Tool search sat below the first screen on phones
No tool-category section, so most of the catalogue was one extra click away
No section explaining why to use the tools or who runs the site
The guides list was only the newest nine posts, not an editorial selection
Header button pointed to the blog although the tools are the main offer
Footer listed six tools and no category or sitemap links

technical.apexRedirect: https://byteverse.fyi/ answers 307 (temporary) to www. A permanent redirect is a Vercel domain setting and cannot be changed in code.
technical.previousHtml: About 158 KB HTML and 10 scripts on the live homepage

research.method: Public Google autocomplete for 28 seeds, DuckDuckGo result pages for 7 queries, server-HTML review of 14 competitor homepages plus screenshots, and the site's own private Search Console export (figures kept out of this repository).
research.serpFinding: For "free online developer tools", "free online tools for developers" and "online developer tools" every result was a tool directory or a list of tools. Titles follow the pattern "Free Online Developer Tools" and many advertise 100 or more tools.
competitorPatterns: Centred hero that names the offer in the main heading
Large search box as the first control
A short row of frequently used tools
Blanket privacy and popularity claims, which were not copied
research.positioning: ByteVerse has 44 tools and cannot compete on catalogue size. The homepage leads with tools plus troubleshooting guides, a per-tool note on where data is processed, and a named editor.

keywordMap.placement: Title, main heading, meta description, hero intro and section headings. Individual tool queries (JSON formatter, regex tester and so on) stay on their own tool pages.

unavailable: Search volume and keyword difficulty (no paid keyword tool)
Bing autocomplete returned no usable response
Four of seven result-page queries returned HTTP 202 with no results
nextool.co, onedev.tools and freeformatter.com could not be fetched as server HTML
it-tools.tech, smalldev.tools and transform.tools render with JavaScript only, so their headings were not readable
Competitor traffic, rankings and conversion data

decisions.title: Free Online Developer Tools & Tech Guides | ByteVerse
decisions.h1: Free online developer tools and practical tech guides
decisions.description: Built from the live tool count; 120 to 160 characters; mentions no sign-up.
decisions.featuredToolsBasis: Editorial selection. The page does not call them most popular.
decisions.categoryLinks: Each category card opens the matching section of /tools (formatters-dev, encoders-converters, security-crypto, seo-web, content-analysis, css-design).
notAdded: SearchAction markup: there is no URL search route and Google retired the sitelinks search box
Testimonials, user counts, ratings or usage rankings: no verified data exists
An editor photo: none was supplied, so initials are shown
decisions.analytics: Clicks are reported through the existing gtag as home_tool_click, home_shortcut_click, home_category_click, home_guide_click, home_topic_click, home_trust_click, home_cta_click, home_search_result_click and home_tool_search. Search terms are cut to 40 characters and sent after a 1.2 second pause.

implementation: src/app/page.tsx: new section structure; guide titles are the links and stretch over the card
src/app/home-premium.module.css: design rules based on the shared theme variables, compact phone rows, right-to-left, reduced motion and forced colours
src/lib/homepage.ts: copy, featured tools, shortcuts, categories with counts, benefits, curated guides, editor details, questions and structured data
src/lib/homepage-data.ts: two compact queries (curated guides and newest posts)
src/components/homepage-tool-finder.tsx and its stylesheet: hero search with aliases, arrow keys, Enter and Escape
src/components/homepage-analytics.tsx and src/lib/homepage-events.ts: click reporting through the existing tag
src/components/footer.tsx: Free tools, Guides, ByteVerse and Legal columns
src/components/header.tsx and src/lib/config.ts: "Free tools" button and Home, Tools, Blog, Categories, About, Contact order

scripts/test-homepage.mjs, scripts/test-homepage-browser.mjs, scripts/homepage-fixtures.mjs, scripts/homepage-public-preview.mjs, scripts/preview-homepage.mjs, scripts/check-homepage-live.mjs, scripts/test-image-studio-browser.mjs: tests and preview tooling updated for the new structure

browserCoverage: Server-rendered content, metadata and lazy covers
Hero search, keyboard use and event reporting
Category cards land on the matching /tools section
320, 390, 768, 1280 and 1440 pixel widths in light and dark with axe WCAG A and AA checks
Theme toggle, forced colours, reduced motion and the mobile menu
Social image renders as a 1200 x 630 PNG
validation.lint: PASS: changed source files and homepage scripts
validation.visualReview: Edge screenshots reviewed at 1440 and 390 pixels in light and dark, plus the footer, the right-to-left layout and the /tools page with the new header and footer.

mobileLab.interpretation: Scores moved by more than ten points between runs of the same build on this machine, and the two hosts differ, so no performance gain or loss is claimed. The first local run flagged guide-card link names that did not match the visible text; that was fixed and did not recur.
caveats: Lab runs only, not field data
Local preview and the live CDN are not directly comparable
Third-party scripts are part of the live figures

liveAfterChange.note: Within the same run-to-run spread as the four runs before the change; the guide-card link-name warning seen on the old live page did not appear.

liveVerification.result: PASS at 390 and 1440 pixels in light and dark
confirmed: Title and main heading match the decisions above
Canonical https://www.byteverse.fyi/ and robots index, follow
Organization, WebSite and WebPage structured data present; no FAQPage
All nine sections present, 8 featured tools, 6 category links, 12 distinct guide links
No horizontal overflow and no page errors
All 46 internal links on the homepage answered 200
Homepage is listed in the XML sitemap
notes: Homepage HTML is about 187 KB, up from about 158 KB, because of the added sections and the in-page tool search list; the script count stayed at 10
The apex domain still answers 307 to www

limitations: No ranking or traffic outcome is promised
Keyword wording comes from autocomplete and result pages, not measured demand
The apex-to-www redirect remains temporary until the Vercel domain setting is changed
